limitations: Archived spec registry source is not independently verified against the installed Conquest Reborn client version.
The client class advancement JSON has tabs, abilities, traits, and links; it does not itself provide a canonical live class/spec API dump.

A name/tab match is a candidate mapping, not proof of active spec availability. Resolve with live C_ClassInfo.GetAllSpecs/GetSpecInfoByID and C_CharacterAdvancement.GetActiveChrSpec when runtime testing is possible.
Historical spell database and spellbook snapshot do not prove a spell is currently available or behaves as represented.
Static files cannot establish summon ownership, combat log flags, or runtime ability use.
Large MPQ archives were inventoried but not extracted; no archives copied.
No SavedVariables, combat logs, or personal account data included.
